summary: Describes how to carry voicemail messages over Internet mail as part of a unified messaging setup. Internet Voice Messaging is not a successor to VPIM version 2 but an alternative specification for a different application. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: This lets a voice message travel like a normal email, so you can listen to it from your inbox. It is a different tool from the older voice mail system, built for a different job.
